text: Don't add the template's docs to .gitignore: the template repo keeps its own plans, records, contracts, MEMORY.md and ROADMAP.md tracked.
During initial setup, clean up the docs: init removes every workbench-specific doc so a new or adopted workbench starts with empty plan folders and fresh MEMORY.md and ROADMAP.md.
Add a skill that refreshes future instances of workbenches from the template without the workbench-specific docs.

Workbench-specific docs are the template repo's own development docs: docs/plans epics and records (todo, in-progress, done), docs/plans/contracts.json, index.json, facts.md, docs/research, and the template's MEMORY.md and ROADMAP.md entries; README.md, docs/enterprise.md, docs/harnesses.md and plugin docs are user docs and ship.
